requirements.requirement: The system must generate at least one state_board_url based on the provider's primary practice state using existing logic in provider_detail_service.py.
The system must include all generated state_board_urls in the malpractice evidence_links field of the output object.
The system must detect a negative malpractice indicator when provider NPI status is deactivated or flagged as inactive.
The system must set npdb_flag to true, false, or unknown based on availability of proxy data and must not default unknown to false.
The system must compute action_count as the total number of detected negative indicators from all available sources.
The system must assign a severity_score that decreases as action_count increases.
The system must not increase or positively adjust severity_score when no negative indicators are present.
The system must return a malpractice object conforming to the schema defined in EVAL-P-MALPRACTICE-SCHEMA-001.
The system must set severity_score to a neutral baseline value when action_count equals zero.
The system must include an empty list for state_board_actions when no actions are detected rather than null.
The system must handle missing provider state by returning an empty state_board_urls list and marking data as unknown.
The system must handle unavailable NPI or sanctions data by setting npdb_flag to unknown and not affecting severity_score.
The system must ensure severity_score is always within a predefined bounded range (e.g., 0 to 1 or 0 to 100).
The system must treat multiple negative indicators as additive in impact rather than overriding previous signals.
The system must not fabricate or infer state_board_actions in the absence of verified or proxy data sources.
